info.title: UniCloud Portal: the portal app's JSON API (pinned contract)
info.description: The 'Portal UI' part of the fork's api/openapi.json (Alex-Tsvetanov/unicloud-portal, branch rust-rewrite, commit c16da1a), unchanged. The React app on staging speaks exactly this. The Java portal serves these paths, fields and status codes, and adds HAL-FORMS _links and _templates to the same answers (openspec/changes/react-hypermedia-ui). Fields and paths here are never renamed or removed; additions are allowed.

tags.name: Portal UI
tags.description: The portal's own single-page app. Same-site only: session cookie plus `X-CSRF-Token` on changes. Not for modules.
